newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to hold 10-yr JGB auction next week -sources.
newsitem.headline: Japan to hold 10-yr JGB auction next week -sources.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) will hold a 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) auction next week, bond market sources said on Tuesday.
There was market talk last Friday that the ministry might postpone a 10-year JGB auction usually set for the end of March, to April.

The talk was partly prompted by speculation that Nomura Securities Co Ltd might be suspended from underwriting JGBs for several months following its disclosure that two of its directors made apparently illegal deals.
The talk was a key factor fuelling the JGB rally on Friday, bond traders said.

The yield of the cash benchmark 182nd 10-year JGB hit a record low of 2.185 percent on Monday. But it recovered sharply to 2.285 percent by Tuesday due to a senior Bank of Japan official's comments implying that the recent surge in JGBs had been overdone, bond traders said.
